findings.title: Post-logout access JWT accepted when Redis deny-list write failed but read returns cache miss
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-613 / OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures
findings.exploit_path: 1. Attacker holds a stolen access JWT (jti = session id). 2. Victim calls POST /api/auth/logout; Accounts.logout/1 deletes the Postgres Session row then best-effort ExpiredSessions.revoke/1. 3. If Redis PUT fails during revoke/1, no deny-list key is stored. 4. On subsequent auth, ExpiredSessions.revoked?/1 gets {:ok, nil} from Redis (read succeeds, key absent) and returns false without consulting Postgres. 5. Accounts.authenticate_access_token/1 accepts the JWT until access exp (15 minutes).
findings.disprover_notes: Confirmed by independent disprover pass. Postgres fallback in revoked?/1 applies only on Redis read {:error, _}, not on {:ok, nil}. Requires prior token compromise and Redis write failure at logout; bounded by access_ttl. Refresh path still blocked via missing Session row.
findings.remediation: On {:ok, nil}, fall back to revoked_via_postgres?/1 (or always require an active Session row for authenticate_access_token/1). Alternatively treat failed revoke/1 as requiring synchronous Postgres session tombstone or out-of-band alert.

findings.title: Cookie-authenticated POST /api/auth/refresh lacks CSRF token or Origin check (same-site subdomain exposure)
findings.cwe_owasp: CWE-352 / OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control
findings.exploit_path: 1. POST /api/auth/refresh authenticates solely via HttpOnly SameSite=Lax refresh cookie with no CSRF or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site check. 2. Cross-site POSTs from third-party origins are blocked by SameSite=Lax + CORSPlug. 3. A sibling subdomain on the same eTLD+1 may force refresh rotation or reuse revocation.
findings.disprover_notes: Needs validation of production DNS/origin topology (untrusted sibling subdomains). Third-party CSRF mitigated by SameSite=Lax.
findings.remediation: Require double-submit CSRF, custom header, or Origin/Sec-Fetch-Site == same-origin on POST /api/auth/refresh, or SameSite=Strict if compatible.

findings.disprover_notes: Rejected (remediated). verify_access/1 and verify_refresh/1 call validate_time_claims/1 with explicit validate_exp/validate_nbf; tests added in accounts/tokens_test.exs.
